conversation_events_tool_correlation_idx.name: conversation_events_tool_correlation_idx
conversation_events_tool_correlation_idx.where: ("conversation_events"."event_type" = 'tool_call' AND "conversation_events"."tool_call_id" IS NOT NULL) OR "conversation_events"."tool_result_for_id" IS NOT NULL

github_integrations_claim_fields_check.name: github_integrations_claim_fields_check
github_integrations_claim_fields_check.value: ("github_integrations"."installation_status" = 'unclaimed' AND "github_integrations"."organization_id" IS NULL AND "github_integrations"."connected_by_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("github_integrations"."installation_status" = 'active' AND "github_integrations"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "github_integrations"."connected_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("github_integrations"."installation_status" = 'suspended')
